boundary_condition: This applies only to flight onboard connectivity amenities, not to destination choice, airline loyalty, cabin class, schedule, lodging, or ground transportation.
condition: When comparing or booking flight options and onboard amenities are available as filters or descriptors, use free onboard Wi-Fi as a preferred amenity.
default_action: Prefer flight options that include free Wi-Fi; if free Wi-Fi is not clearly available, look for flights with Wi-Fi availability and flag whether it is free.
exception_condition: If no otherwise acceptable flight offers free Wi-Fi, do not fail the booking automatically; present the best matching non-free-Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi-available options and call out the tradeoff.
name: Prioritizes flights with free Wi-Fi
rationale: Across independent scripted flight-search conversations, users repeatedly ask for free Wi-Fi as a desired flight amenity. Some utterances make it a need, while others phrase it as preferred or conditional on availability, so the controlled synthetic default should prioritize but not make it an absolute universal requirement.

source_evidence.contribution: The user states, “I also need free Wi-Fi,” supporting free onboard Wi-Fi as a valued flight feature.
The user says they “need something with free Wi-Fi,” grounding the amenity preference in a flight search.
The user asks for “free Wi-Fi, or Wi-Fi available,” supporting a default that prioritizes free Wi-Fi but can fall back to Wi-Fi availability.
The user wants “a non-stop flight with free Wi-Fi if that's available,” supporting a preferred amenity with an availability caveat.
The user says “there should be free Wi-Fi in the flights” because they have work to do, reinforcing the reusable flight-feature preference.

source_examples.user_utterance: I would like to pay up to $1,500, I need something with free Wi-Fi, I prefer business but the economy is also okay with me.
I would prefer business class and also a flight that has like free Wi-Fi, or Wi-Fi available.
The particular airlines don't matter to me. I hope for a non-coach class is okay. I want a non-stop flight with free Wi-Fi if that's available.
All right. Well, when you're searching, just know that I'm okay with layovers. And, there should be free Wi-Fi in the flights. I have a lot of work to do.
